By Jacob Rivera, Creative Director at Ultimate Snooze

Amazon's Prime sales event has become one of the biggest shopping moments of the summer. If you've been waiting for the right moment to invest in your sleep, this is it. While everyone else is refreshing their carts for deals on tech and home goods, The Ultimate Snooze is running Ultimate Sleep Week, June 20-26, with 20% off sitewide and a FREE set of Breezeline Organic Cooling Sheets (a $449 value) included with every mattress purchase.

Same shopping energy. A much more meaningful upgrade.

Why Sleep Is the Best Investment You Can Make This Prime Season

Most things people buy during a major sale event get used for a few months and forgotten. A mattress is something your body spends 7 to 9 hours on every single night for the next decade or more. The quality of what you sleep on directly affects how well you recover, how you feel when you wake up, and how you perform every day after.

If you've been thinking about upgrading your sleep setup, a sale week is the right time to do it. And The Ultimate Snooze is built specifically for people who take that investment seriously.

The Deal: 20% Off + Free Organic Sheets (a $449 Value)

During Ultimate Sleep Week, every mattress purchase includes a complimentary set of our Breezeline Organic Cooling Sheets in your choice of size and color, a $449 value at no additional cost. Combined with 20% off the mattress itself, here is exactly what you save:

Both mattresses come with a 100-night trial and a 30-year warranty, so your purchase is protected long after the sale ends.

Which Mattress Is Right for You?

The Pillowtop (Medium-Plush) is designed for sleepers who want a soft, cushioned feel at the pressure points. The pillowtop comfort layer lets the shoulders and hips settle in comfortably while the natural latex core maintains spinal support underneath. It's a great fit for side sleepers and anyone who finds firmer mattresses too rigid.

The Pure (Medium-Firm) suits sleepers who want responsive support with clean, natural materials throughout. It provides enough contouring to relieve pressure without excess softness, making it a strong choice for back sleepers, combination sleepers, or anyone who tends to sleep hot and wants a more breathable, supportive feel.

Not sure which is right for you? Both come with a 100-night trial. Your body will tell you within the first few weeks.

What Makes The Ultimate Snooze Different

Every mattress in the Ultimate Snooze lineup is built around materials chosen for what they do for your sleep and what they leave out of your bedroom.

Natural latex is breathable, responsive, and built to last. Its open-cell structure allows air to move freely so heat doesn't build up through the night. It contours to the body without the deep sinkage of memory foam and holds its support for years.

Organic wool regulates temperature naturally, wicking moisture and adapting to your body's microclimate through the night. It keeps you cooler when you're warm and warmer when the room is cool, without any chemical treatment.

Organic cotton covers the entire sleep surface in a soft, breathable layer that stays fresh and comfortable from the first night through years of use.

No synthetic foam. No fiberglass. No chemical flame retardants. No off-gassing VOCs. Just clean, natural materials that work with your body instead of against it.

Free Organic Sheets: Any Size, Any Color

Every mattress order during Ultimate Sleep Week includes the Breezeline Organic Cooling Sheet Set in your choice of size (Twin XL, Queen, King, or California King) and color (Ivory, White, Blue, or Gray). Made from 100% organic cotton, these sheets are breathable, soft, and built to pair with your new mattress from night one.

If you'd prefer a cooling upgrade, you can also explore our new 100% Natural Linen Sheets and Blended Linen and Cotton Sheets, both designed for maximum breathability and natural temperature regulation.

20% Off Everything Else Too

The sitewide discount applies to the full store, so if you want to complete your sleep system during Ultimate Sleep Week, now is the time. Browse our adjustable bases, organic pillows, and accessories, all at 20% off alongside your mattress order.

Ultimate Sleep Week: June 20-26

Seven days. 20% off sitewide. Free organic cotton sheets with every mattress. The best price we offer all year on a sleep system built from natural materials, designed for real recovery, and backed by a 100-night trial and 30-year warranty.

Shop now and start your 100-night trial.

Jacob Rivera is the Creative Director at Ultimate Snooze, where he leads brand storytelling and consumer education around sleep health and mattress safety.
